preSprayedProperties.Powder_Particle_Size_Other: 3% of particles were smaller than 11 μm
preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: belt grinded down to 600 grit size and then polished on a velvet cloth. After polishing, washed with petrol and cleaned with caustic soda, followed by demineralized water. submerged in Ni-tank containing an electrolytic mixture of Ni-salt (Chloride staged Ni) and water by high conductivity wires, which were attached to the negative terminal of the voltage source (5 V). In the same fashion, a Ni rod was attached to the positive terminal of the power source. The voltage supply was given for 5-min, then the plate was submerged in a Cu-salt water based solution (Electrolyte) by connecting to the power supply in the same manner and electroplated for 20 min. Ni-salt was composed of nickel sulfamate [Ni(NH2SO3)2·4H2O, 400 mL/L], nickel chloride (NiCl2.6H2O, 10 g/L), and boric acid (H3BO3, 50 g/L). The test was performed at room temperature, with a current density of 4 A/dm2 and a pH value of 4.5. Similarly, Cu-salt was composed of copper sulfate (CuSO4, 220 g/L), sulfuric acid (H2SO4, 55 g/L), and chloride ion (120 ppm). The current density for Cu-electroplating was 1 A/dm2, and it was performed at room temperature. cleaned by swabbing with acetone-dipped cotton prior to the spraying and clamped on a tilting turn-table for stability.

experimentalProperties.Additional_Manufacturing_Processes_Descr: 15 passes used during deposition. The standard metallographic procedure was used to prepare the samples for the SEM/EDS analysis. Before tensile testing, polished with 600 grit sized emery paper. all the specimens were etched with a solution (5 g FeCl3, 5 mL HCl, and 100 mL ethanol) for 15 s by swabbing the solution dipped cotton on the specimens.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: thickness of the electroplated Cu-layer was observed in the range 3–5 μm. Clearly distinguishable splat/particle boundaries were observed. A continuous gap was observed at the interface for Cu-coatings deposited on the Cu-electroplated steel substrate, showing poor adhesion between electroplated Cu and steel substrate. oxide-free
